setupCard.description: Connect a PrestaShop store via the Webservice API. You will need the shop URL and a webservice key.

prestashopConnectionActions.description: Push Base URL, Connection ID, and a freshly-rotated Webhook Secret to the PrestaShop module via WS. Verifies with a synchronous test ping.
prestashopConnectionActions.title: Configure webhooks

configured.description: PrestaShop module updated and verified by a test ping. You're done.
configured.title: Webhooks configured

failed.notAccepted: PrestaShop did not accept the configuration push.
failed.title: Configuration push failed

pingMissing.description: Configuration is in place but the test ping did not arrive. Click again to retry, or wait for the next real event.
pingMissing.title: Webhooks configured (ping not received)

prestashopCredentialsPanel.description: Stored securely on the server. Rotate to replace the key without restarting the API.
prestashopCredentialsPanel.label: Webservice key

toast.description: The new webservice key is now in use.
toast.title: Credentials rotated

callbackUrl.description: OpenLinker's URL from PrestaShop's perspective - used by the PS module to POST webhooks back to OL. Pre-filled with the API address this app uses; override for Docker dev (e.g. http://host.docker.internal:3000) or unusual deploys. Required to use the 'Configure webhooks' action.
callbackUrl.label: OL callback URL

fallbackCarrier.description: Used when an Allegro shipping method has no carrier mapping. Leave unset to use the OpenLinker Dynamic carrier (exact Allegro shipping cost) at sync time - works only when the OL PrestaShop module is installed.
fallbackCarrier.label: Fallback carrier (optional)
fallbackCarrier.noFallbackWarning: No fallback carrier is set and the OpenLinker PrestaShop module isn't installed on this connection. Sync will fail for any Allegro shipping method without a carrier mapping until you pick a fallback or install the OL PS module.
fallbackCarrier.none: None - use OpenLinker Dynamic at runtime

inpostModuleType.description: Select the official InPost PrestaShop module installed on this shop. When set, OL reads the paczkomat locker code from the delivery address during order ingestion. Leave unset if InPost orders are not in use.
inpostModuleType.label: InPost PS module type (optional)

shopId.description: Only needed for multi-shop PrestaShop installations.
shopId.label: Shop ID (optional)

shopUrl.description: The public URL of the PrestaShop storefront.
shopUrl.label: Shop URL

storefrontUrl.description: Override only if your public storefront URL is different from the webservice URL. Leave blank if they're the same - defaults to Shop URL.
storefrontUrl.label: Storefront URL (optional)
